summary: Polaryx Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K to announce its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders will be held virtually on September 10, 2026, with a record date of July 27, 2026. The filing sets a July 27, 2026 deadline for Rule 14a-8 stockholder proposals and director nominations, noting the company did not hold an annual meeting in 2025. There is no special situation event; this is a routine current report providing meeting logistics and governance deadlines. No merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or other special situation is described. The filing serves as a procedural notice for shareholders to submit proposals and nominations.
